_comment: Brand defaults for aiugc-longform: voice IDs, avatar generation prompts, narrative-arc tuning per brand.

huragain.product_context: HurAgain — moringa supplement for menopausal joint pain. Uses high-concentration moringa with phytoestrogens (5x soy/flaxseed). 95% curcuminoids for inflammation. Brand: hernovabottle.com.
huragain.avatar_generation_prompt: candid iPhone selfie photo of a 55-year-old woman with shoulder-length dirty-blonde hair, light blue cotton t-shirt, sitting in a warm wooden kitchen with stainless fridge and recessed ceiling light, soft overhead practical lighting, low chin-up angle as if phone propped on counter, eyes visible at top of frame, slight smile, realistic skin pores and faint smile lines, no makeup, candid framing slightly off-center, shot on iPhone unedited, no AI sheen, 9:16 vertical
huragain.narrative_voice: Rant energy. Conversational, slightly breathless. Uses concrete sensory details (3am wake-ups, rusted hinge feeling, WD-40 metaphor). Subverts authority ("doctors said wear and tear"). Mechanism-heavy mid-section.

lunessa.product_context: Lunessa — Red Yeast Rice + CoQ10 heart health supplement for women 50+. Targets cholesterol, statin side effects, heart palpitations.
lunessa.avatar_generation_prompt: candid iPhone selfie photo of a 56-year-old woman with shoulder-length grey-blonde hair, cream linen top, sitting at a sunlit wooden kitchen counter, north window light, low chin-up angle, eyes at top of frame, neutral closed-mouth expression mid-blink, realistic skin pores and faint freckles, no makeup, slight imperfect framing, shot on iPhone unedited, no AI sheen, 9:16 vertical
lunessa.narrative_voice: Calm authority. Trust-building. Personal anecdote about doctor or bloodwork. Subverts statin narrative. Mentions specific numbers when possible.

motilli.product_context: Motilli — celery juice fiber gummies for GLP-1 users. Supports digestion, bloating, constipation common on GLP-1 (Ozempic / Wegovy).
motilli.avatar_generation_prompt: candid iPhone selfie photo of a 38-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair, casual oversized sweater, sitting on a bathroom counter or bedroom edge with soft window daylight, low chin-up angle, slight smile, realistic skin texture, no makeup, candid imperfect framing, shot on iPhone unedited, no AI sheen, 9:16 vertical
motilli.narrative_voice: Surprised-discovery energy. "I had no idea this was the issue." Mentions GLP-1 by name. Bathroom/digestion specifics.

velantra-boat-tote.product_context: Velantra Boat Tote — canvas + leather, gold hardware, Birkin-inspired silhouette in 14+ colorways.
velantra-boat-tote.avatar_generation_prompt: candid iPhone selfie photo of a 32-year-old woman with long dark hair, neutral cream knit sweater, sitting in the driver seat of a parked car with trees outside the windshield, soft daylight, chest-up framing slightly low angle, eyes visible upper third of frame, neutral mouth, realistic skin texture, candid imperfect framing, shot on iPhone unedited, no AI sheen, 9:16 vertical
velantra-boat-tote.narrative_voice: Aspirational lifestyle. "I bought 3 of these." Mentions price point and quality vs. luxury comparison.
